scope: Metadata, total row counts, three-row schema probes and aggregate-only summaries; not a full-data quality audit or validated join.

boston_packages.title: DND Managed City Property Inventory All

nyc_inspections.name: Rodent Inspection
nyc_inspections.attribution: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH)

columns.name: JOB ID / CASE ID
columns.description: Internal DOHMH administrative number to identify a job, Case ID

columns.name: INSPECTION DATE
columns.description: Date of the inspection.

columns.name: INSPECTION TYPE
columns.description: Includes the types of inspections and health department actions: Initial Inspection - Inspection conducted in response to a 311 complaint, or a proactive inspection conducted through our neighborhood indexing program. Compliance Inspection - If a property fails its initial inspection, the Health Department will conduct a follow up (Compliance) inspection. Baiting - Application of rodenticide, or monitoring visit by a Health Department Pest Control Professional. Clean Up - The removal of garbage and clutter from a property by the Health Department.

columns.name: HOUSE NUMBER
columns.description: The address number of a building on the tax lot that was inspected.

columns.name: STREET NAME
columns.description: The street name portion of the address of the tax lot that was inspected.

columns.name: ZIP CODE
columns.description: The postal zipcode of the tax lot that was inspected.

columns.name: BOROUGH
columns.description: The name of the NYC borough.

columns.name: RESULT
columns.description: Result of the inspection, including: Active Rat Signs (ARS) - ARS include any of six different signs: 1) fresh tracks, 2) fresh droppings, 3) active burrows, 4) active runways and rub marks, 5) fresh gnawing marks, and 6) live rats. Problem Conditions - Problem conditions include garbage (poor containerization of food waste resulting in the feeding of rats), harborage (clutter and dense vegetation promoting the nesting of rats), and mice.

columns.name: LETTER TYPE
columns.description: Records any violation notices or orders to address rat conditions that were issued following an inspection.

columns.name: OBSERVATIONS
columns.description: All inspector observations of rat activity or conditions that attract rats, from the inspection.

columns.name: BBL
columns.description: Borough, Block, and Lot code, which is a unique identifier of NYC Taxlots. Every NYC property has its own BBL code, and inspections are conducted at the taxlot level. This dataset can be mapped by joining these inspectional results to a taxlot geography file such as the Department of City Planning’s PLUTO dataset.

columns.name: BORO CODE
columns.description: The code assigned to the NYC borough, this code can also be found as the first digit in the BBL tax lot code above.

columns.name: BLOCK
columns.description: The block number for the inspected tax lot; block numbers repeat in different boroughs.

columns.name: LOT
columns.description: The lot number for the inspected tax lot; lot numbers can repeat in different blocks.

columns.name: X COORD
columns.description: X coordinate of the inspected tax lot in NY State Plane Long Island Coordinate system.

columns.name: Y COORD
columns.description: Y coordinate of the inspected tax lot in NY State Plane Long Island Coordinate system.

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: Latitude in decimal degrees of the inspected tax lot (WGS 1984).

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: Longitude in decimal degrees of the inspected tax lot (WGS 1984).

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Coordinates (latitude, longitude) of the inspected tax lot (WGS 1984).

columns.name: COMMUNITY BOARD
columns.description: Community Board of the location.

columns.name: COUNCIL DISTRICT
columns.description: Council District of the location.

columns.name: CENSUS TRACT
columns.description: Census Tract of the location.

columns.name: BIN
columns.description: Department of Buildings (DOB) Building Identification Number.

columns.name: NTA
columns.description: NTA (Neighborhood Tabulation Area) code of the location.
